prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for [choose_path, redesign], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] as each category has only one test.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] and [adoption, new_screen] remains mixed: for each category, one test won while the other showed no clear effect.
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] remains inconsistent across four tests: one won (+5.5% after noise correction), two were worse or stopped early (-8.3% and -4.0%), and one showed no clear effect.
[finish, redesign] changes can be helpful, as two of five tests won (+5.5% and +4.3% after noise correction), while three showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too low for all winning tests.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early, lost, or showed no clear effect, with round 11 as a rare exception.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +3.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:

- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Launch Preflight Status Screen: Adds a preflight setup status screen before waiting that verifies desktop rendering permissions and display drivers. (why: Support received 3 tickets reporting pets failing to display on desktop or app refusing to open.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Angle Photo Assistant and Generation Checklist Flow: Introduces a step-by-step photo validation sub-flow that guides users on optimal lighting and angles before submitting custom pet photos. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation errors or distorted pet appearances; adoption step takes 1017s mean time.)
2: [home, wait_info] Interactive Generation Status Progress Tracker: Replaces static waiting text with step-by-step progress indicators showing texture generation, animation rigging, and desktop placement stages. (why: Home waiting step has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; users need clear feedback while assets render.)
3: [adoption, hint] Pet Certificate Naming Guidance Tip: Adds a contextual micro-copy tip under the pet naming field suggesting popular naming themes and character limits. (why: Adoption step has a median time of 89s; subtle naming tips reduce decision friction.)
4: [finish, incentive] Onboarding Completion Pioneer Title Perk: Displays a badge celebrating successful onboarding completion and unlocks an exclusive 'Pioneer Pet Parent' desktop pet title. (why: Overall onboarding conversion is 28.0%; offering a clear reward upon completion motivates users to reach the end.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Style Preview and Selection Screen: Inserts a new preview screen before path selection demonstrating animated desktop pet behaviors for each companion style. (why: Choosing a path has mean time of 514s and 76.2% conversion; visual previews reduce uncertainty.)
